overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the topic "Update for Certification & Classification schedule" met the posting minimum, though the Board was strongly encouraged to add detail. The separate public-hearing/comment claim was declined.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board's November 30 notice topic, 'Update for Certification & Classification schedule,' lacked sufficient detail because it did not say the Board would discuss tax classifications.
allegations.key_passage: we find that, in this instance, the topic as posted, "Update for Certification & Classification schedule," met the minimum requirements for posting notice under the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the public lacked sufficient time for adequate review and comment on the proposed FY2018 tax classifications; this is a separate public hearing question, not an Open Meeting Law issue.
allegations.key_passage: Given that our office is charged specifically with reviewing complaints to determine compliance with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25, we decline to review, and offer no opinion on, whether there was a violation of any separate public hearing law.
